reason: The fast rocky projectiles are the visible stones that can encounter the moon-bearing world.

choice.combine: The rocky world with a small moon

expectation: The projectiles will strike the rocky world, advancing the first goal.

effect: The world combined with its host star instead; that encounter included the remaining stones and completed the first goal.
reaction: I was surprised that the disk encounter was made through the star rather than the projectiles.
reason: The exposed gas and inner-disk hotspot appear directly related, so this is a reasonable way to follow the remaining material.

choice.combine: Exposed gas carrying small dust grains

expectation: The gas and dust will undergo a change in the exposed disk, helping trace their fate.

effect: The exposed gas and dust escaped the disk into the surrounding nursery, tracing the returned material.
reaction: The contrast between retained worlds and escaping birth material is interesting.
reason: The shattered-body fragments are the remaining visible material among the planets; inspecting them should reveal how to follow their fate.

choice.inspect: Fragments of a shattered small body

expectation: The inspection will identify an available partner for the fragments.

effect: The inspection revealed a single partner and automatically combined the fragments with the projectiles, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the shattered body's fragments traced to a different fate from the rubble world.

mostWorthwhile.text: Returning disk material to the nursery connected the planetary system back to the larger galactic encounter, while distinguishing escaping material from retained worlds.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first attempt was confusing: the projectiles seemed like the natural partner, but the world instead combined automatically with its host star.

surprise.text: The rocky world's encounter with the remaining stones happened through the host-star combination rather than directly with the projectiles.

arbitrary.text: Using the star as the partner for the world's encounter with stones felt somewhat arbitrary from the visible board, although the result explained the wider view.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: following material from the disk back into the nursery made me curious about its later encounters.
